list.name: patient
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM surge_evaluations ORDER BY patient_id

list.name: focus_patient
list.label: Drill into
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM surge_evaluations ORDER BY patient_id

panels.title: Active Seizures
panels.description: Confirmed seizure events happening now or in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE severity='critical' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id IN ($patient)

panels.title: Possible / Mild Events
panels.description: Events flagged but not severe enough to count as a confirmed seizure -- worth a look, not an emergency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM alert_episodes WHERE severity='warning' AND $__timeFilter(start_time) AND patient_id IN ($patient)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS value FROM surge_evaluations WHERE patient_id IN ($patient)

panels.title: Device / Sensor Faults
panels.description: Hardware readings outside the safe range -- a failing electrode or an over-limit stimulation setting, not a brain event.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM device_health WHERE severity != 'normal' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND patient_id IN ($patient)

panels.title: Active Alerts
panels.description: One row per event (not per split-second reading). Spread tells you whether it stayed in one area of the brain (Focal) or looks like a whole-head movement artifact (Widespread).

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.start_time AS 'Time', e.patient_id AS 'Patient', e.severity AS 'Severity', CASE e.alert_type WHEN 'SEIZURE_SURGE' THEN 'Seizure' WHEN 'SUBCLINICAL' THEN 'Mild / brief event' WHEN 'SIGNAL_QUALITY' THEN 'Bad sensor data' ELSE e.alert_type END AS 'What Happened', c.anatomical_location AS 'Brain Region', CASE WHEN (LENGTH(e.channels_involved) - LENGTH(REPLACE(e.channels_involved,',','')) + 1) <= 2 THEN 'Focal' ELSE 'Widespread' END AS 'Spread', ROUND(e.duration_ms) AS 'Duration (ms)', e.stim_delivered AS 'Treatment Fired' FROM alert_episodes e LEFT JOIN channels c ON c.channel_id = e.onset_channel WHERE $__timeFilter(e.start_time) AND e.patient_id IN ($patient) ORDER BY e.end_time DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Seizure Intensity & Treatment Response — $focus_patient
panels.description: How intense the event looked to the detector, over time. Orange markers show when the implant's own stimulation therapy actually fired.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '1s'), 'intensity' AS metric, MAX(surge_index) AS value FROM surge_evaluations WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND patient_id = '$focus_patient' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT event_time AS time, 'treatment_fired' AS metric, surge_index AS value FROM surge_evaluations WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND patient_id = '$focus_patient' AND stim_active = 1 ORDER BY event_time
